key_definitions.balanced_accuracy: Saved balanced accuracy, independently recomputed from the 7x7 confusion matrix.
key_definitions.condition: E4 altered cohort/treatment condition recorded in registry.
key_definitions.evaluation_sha256: SHA-256 of the actual canonical artifacts/<task_key>/evaluation.json bytes read by the analyzer.
key_definitions.method: Classifier/generator family recorded for the evaluation.
key_definitions.ratio: Target share ratio for altered cohort, typically 0.5 or 0.1; null for controls.
key_definitions.registry_task_row_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact serialized tasks.record string for this task_key in the SQLite read-only snapshot; the record includes its nested result.validation metadata.
key_definitions.score_kind: Recorded conformal score convention; numeric thresholds from different score kinds are not compared.
key_definitions.target_class: Zero-based target class index; null for unchanged controls.
key_definitions.target_coverage: Saved coverage for the altered condition target class; null for unchanged-control metric rows.
key_definitions.target_recall: Saved recall for the altered condition target class; null for unchanged-control metric rows.
key_definitions.target_set_size: Saved mean prediction-set size for the altered condition target class; null for unchanged-control metric rows.
key_definitions.treatment: E4 treatment name; null for direct evaluations.
key_definitions.validation_sha256: The expected SHA-256 value stored at tasks.record.result.validation.files["evaluation.json"]. The analyzer compared this expected digest to the actual evaluation.json digest; it is the evaluation-file digest, not the hash of a validation.json/receipt object.

note: The pre-existing EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json remains unchanged; these two dictionary files are additive and are not retroactively represented in its output list.

receipt_locator.separate_validation_receipt_file_hash: not exported or claimed; registry_task_row_sha256 binds the serialized row containing the embedded validation receipt

scope: Clarifies columns in the E4 bounded descriptive outputs; it does not modify or reissue metric tables.
